literal: Wang Xin; younger brother Xi
idiomatic: Wang Xin; Wang Xi

literal: Wang Xin, styled Yuanjing, was a man of Ju in Beihai commandery.
idiomatic: Wang Xin, styled Yuanjing, was a man of Ju in Beihai commandery.

literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Meng was chancellor under Fu Jian of Former Qin; the family settled at Fucheng in Huashan.
idiomatic: His sixth-generation ancestor Meng had been chancellor under Fu Jian of Former Qin; the family settled at Fucheng in Huashan.

literal: His father Yun served the Wei court with repute.
idiomatic: His father Yun served the Wei court with repute.

literal: In youth Xin was devoted to learning and reading; Grand Marshal Prince of Runan Yue engaged him as cavalry staff officer.
idiomatic: In youth Xin was devoted to learning and reading; Grand Marshal Prince of Runan Yue engaged him as cavalry staff officer.

literal: By custom, when a prince went out shooting, attendants wore martial garb and carried blades in escort; Xin never took his place in the ranks.
idiomatic: By custom, when a prince went out shooting, attendants wore martial garb and carried blades in escort; Xin never took his place in the ranks.

literal: Yue loved idle wandering and sometimes galloped away for nights at a time; Xin would each time abandon the outing and return.
idiomatic: Yue loved idle wandering and sometimes galloped away for nights at a time; Xin would each time abandon the outing and return.

literal: Yue then had him ride in front and drove the horse with his own hand.
idiomatic: Yue then had him ride in front and drove the horse with his own hand.

literal: Xin let go the reins and sat with hands folded high; he let Yue take him wherever.
idiomatic: Xin let go the reins and sat with hands folded high, letting Yue take him wherever he would.

literal: Those about said he was insolently slow.
idiomatic: Those about him said he was insolently slow.

literal: Yue said: "The house's hope is in this worthy alone; he cannot be blamed.
idiomatic: Yue said, "The house's hope is in this worthy alone; he cannot be blamed.

literal: " Yue often scattered cash on the ground and had his staff scramble for it; Xin alone did not pick any up.
idiomatic: " Yue often scattered cash on the ground and had his staff scramble for it; Xin alone did not pick any up.

literal: Yue scattered silver coins with his eye on Xin; Xin then took one.
idiomatic: Yue scattered silver coins with his eye on Xin; Xin then took one.

literal: Yue drank with his household staff; he rose and moved the couch himself.
idiomatic: Yue drank with his household staff; he rose and moved the couch himself.

literal: Others scrambled to lend a hand; Xin alone held his tablet and stepped back.
idiomatic: Others scrambled to lend a hand; Xin alone held his tablet and stepped back.

literal: Yue then darkened his face and said: "I am the emperor's grandson, son, brother, and uncle; today at a feast I rise to move the couch myself.
idiomatic: Yue then darkened his face and said, "I am the emperor's grandson, son, brother, and uncle; today at a feast I rise to move the couch myself.

literal: What sort of man are you, to stand alone in such arrogance!
idiomatic: What sort of man are you, to stand alone in such arrogance!

literal: " He replied: "Yuanjing's rank and standing are slight and low, unworthy of having Your Highness bow and show your bearing; how dare I, a prince's staff officer, follow menial service like groom and stable hand.
idiomatic: " He replied, "Yuanjing's rank and standing are slight and low, unworthy of having Your Highness bow and show your bearing; how dare I, a prince's staff officer, follow menial service like groom and stable hand.

literal: " Yue apologized.
idiomatic: " Yue apologized.

literal: All at the seat drank their fill in high spirits; Xin rose first and lay in an idle room; summoned repeatedly, he did not come.
idiomatic: All at the seat drank their fill in high spirits; Xin rose first and lay in an idle room; summoned repeatedly, he did not come.

literal: Yue then came in person and called: "You cherish talent yet slight the house master—can that be called humane?
idiomatic: Yue then came in person and called, "You cherish talent yet slight the house master—can that be called humane?

literal: " Xin said: "King Zhou of Shang sank in debauchery; his fall came in an instant. The house master slighted himself; may a petty officer bear the blame?
idiomatic: " Xin said, "King Zhou of Shang sank in debauchery; his fall came in an instant. The house master slighted himself; may a petty officer bear the blame?

literal: " Yue laughed loud and left.
idiomatic: " Yue laughed loud and left.

literal: He rose in succession to Administrator of Donglai.
idiomatic: He rose in succession to administrator of Donglai.

literal: Later Minister of Personnel Li Shenjun memorialized saying that because of many disturbances the attendant-at-court posts had long had no fixed quota; now Wang Yuanjing and others were made attendants, fixed at eight.
idiomatic: Later Minister of Personnel Li Shenjun memorialized that because of many disturbances the attendant-at-court posts had long had no fixed quota; now Wang Yuanjing and others were made attendants, fixed at eight.

literal: He was given the additional title Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
idiomatic: He was given the additional title grand master of splendid happiness with golden seal and purple ribbon.

literal: Emperor Wu of Wei sometimes went bare-chested and sported familiarly with close ministers; whenever he saw Xin, he would straighten his cap and compose his bearing.
idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Wei sometimes went bare-chested and sported familiarly with close ministers; whenever he saw Xin, he would straighten his cap and compose his bearing.

literal: Xin's body had always been very stout; after mourning he remained gaunt for life.
idiomatic: Xin's body had always been very stout; after mourning he remained gaunt for life.

literal: Yang Yin valued his virtue and learning and took him as a model for men.
idiomatic: Yang Yin valued his virtue and learning and took him as a model for men.

literal: He was moved to Director of the Secretariat.
idiomatic: He was moved to director of the secretariat.

literal: In youth Xin and Xing Shao had both been guests of Yuan Luo; when Xin held Donglai, Shao brought his whole household to join him.
idiomatic: In youth Xin and Xing Shao had both been guests of Yuan Luo; when Xin held Donglai, Shao brought his whole household to join him.

literal: The people of the commandery, because Shao was a cousin of Xing Gao, were mustering troops to seize him; Xin shielded him with his own body lying atop him and cried: "If you wish to seize Xing Zicai, you must kill me first.
idiomatic: The people of the commandery, because Shao was a cousin of Xing Gao, were mustering troops to seize him; Xin shielded him with his own body lying atop him and cried, "If you wish to seize Xing Zicai, you must kill me first.

literal: " Shao was thus spared.
idiomatic: " Shao was thus spared.

literal: Xin was fond of pure talk; his words had nothing shallow or vulgar.
idiomatic: Xin was fond of pure talk; his words had nothing shallow or vulgar.

literal: In Donglai he caught one who had killed a traveling companion; questioned, the man would not confess; Xin said to him: "That man died and did not return; you came back unharmed—how will you clear yourself?
idiomatic: In Donglai he caught one who had killed a traveling companion; questioned, the man would not confess; Xin said to him, "That man died and did not return; you came back unharmed—how will you clear yourself?

literal: " Later Xing Shao saw Gao Cheng and told this remark for a laugh.
idiomatic: " Later Xing Shao saw Gao Cheng and told this remark for a laugh.

literal: When Xin heard of it, he went deliberately to Shao and said: "You do not understand creation.
idiomatic: When Xin heard of it, he went deliberately to Shao and said, "You do not understand creation.

literal: " Returning, he told others: "Zicai ought to die; I cursed him to the utmost."
idiomatic: " Returning, he told others, "Zicai ought to die; I cursed him to the utmost."

literal: Gao Yang, because Xin was loose and insolent and not what the age required, reviled him: "Fine house, vile person.
idiomatic: Gao Yang, because Xin was loose and insolent and not what the age required, reviled him, "Fine house, vile person.

literal: " There were also slanderers who said: "Wang Yuanjing often sighs that the water transport ought not to have been cut off.
idiomatic: " There were also slanderers who said, "Wang Yuanjing often sighs that the water transport ought not to have been cut off.

literal: " The emperor grew angrier still and issued an edict exiling him to Youzhou.
idiomatic: " Gao Yang grew angrier still and issued an edict exiling him to Youzhou.

literal: Later he was recalled and made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal and Purple Ribbon, with concurrent charge of the ministry of rites.
idiomatic: Later he was recalled and made grand master of splendid happiness with silver seal and purple ribbon, with concurrent charge of the ministry of rites.

literal: The emperor in anger toward Linzhang magistrate Ji Ye and palace attendant Li Wenshi gave Ye as slave to Xue Fengluo and Wenshi as slave to Cui Shishun.
idiomatic: Gao Yang in anger toward Linzhang magistrate Ji Ye and palace attendant Li Wenshi gave Ye as slave to Xue Fengluo and Wenshi as slave to Cui Shishun.

literal: Zheng Zimo said privately to Xin: "From antiquity there have been no court gentlemen made slaves.
idiomatic: Zheng Zimo said privately to Xin, "From antiquity there have been no court gentlemen made slaves.

literal: " Xin said: "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?
idiomatic: " Xin said, "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?

literal: " Zimo then reported Xin's words to Gao Yang, adding: "Wang Yuanjing compares Your Majesty to King Zhou of Shang.
idiomatic: " Zimo then reported Xin's words to Gao Yang, adding, "Wang Yuanjing compares Your Majesty to King Zhou of Shang.

literal: " Yang Yin mildly excused him.
idiomatic: " Yang Yin mildly excused him.

literal: The emperor said to Yin: "Wang Yuanjing is your doctoral mentor; your every word is what Yuanjing taught.
idiomatic: Gao Yang said to Yin, "Wang Yuanjing is your doctoral mentor; your every word is what Yuanjing taught.

literal: " Later the emperor drank deep with the court ministers; Xin pleaded illness and did not attend.
idiomatic: " Later Gao Yang drank deep with the court ministers; Xin pleaded illness and did not attend.

literal: The emperor sent riders to seize him; they found him swaying his knees and chanting poetry; he was beheaded before the throne, the corpse cast into the Zhang River—in the tenth year of Tianbao.
idiomatic: Gao Yang sent riders to seize him; they found him swaying his knees and chanting poetry; he was beheaded before the throne, the corpse cast into the Zhang River—in the tenth year of Tianbao.

literal: He left a collected works in twenty scrolls.
idiomatic: He left collected works in twenty scrolls.

literal: His son Yan.
idiomatic: His son Yan.

literal: Xin's mother was a Lady Cui of Qinghe, learned and with moral instruction; she bore nine sons, all cultured and refined—the age called them the Nine Dragons of the Wang house.
idiomatic: Xin's mother was a Lady Cui of Qinghe, learned and with moral instruction; she bore nine sons, all cultured and refined—the age called them the Nine Dragons of the Wang house.

literal: His younger brother Xi, styled Shulang, childhood name Shamini.
idiomatic: His younger brother Xi, styled Shulang, childhood name Shamini.

literal: From childhood he was filial and careful, cultivated and with capacity, tireless in learning, handsome in bearing, with natural dignity.
idiomatic: From childhood he was filial and careful, cultivated and with capacity, tireless in learning, handsome in bearing, with natural dignity.

literal: At the end of Wei he followed his mother and elder brothers east to the seacoast and kept company with Xing Ziliang.
idiomatic: At the end of Wei he followed his mother and elder brothers east to the seacoast and kept company with Xing Ziliang.

literal: Ziliang loved his clarity and insight and wrote to Xi's two elder brothers in Luoyang: "Your worthy younger brother Milang's mind is deep and far-reaching, free and unrestrained, spare even in haste; his words always hit reason; in chanting feeling and nature he is often surpassingly fine.
idiomatic: Ziliang loved his clarity and insight and wrote to Xi's two elder brothers in Luoyang, "Your worthy younger brother Milang's mind is deep and far-reaching, free and unrestrained, spare even in haste; his words always hit reason; in chanting feeling and nature he is often surpassingly fine.

literal: I fear you gentlemen will hardly be his match as elder brothers and need not worry that he will not advance.
idiomatic: I fear you gentlemen will hardly be his match as elder brothers and need not worry that he will not advance.

literal: " At the beginning of Yong'an in Wei, his second elder brother Hui was betrothed to Liang; he memorialized that Xi be released from commoner status and made Attendant Cavalier, and Xi was summoned to serve as recorder on the staff of Prince of Guangping's opening office.
idiomatic: " At the beginning of Yong'an in Wei, his second elder brother Hui was betrothed to Liang; he memorialized that Xi be released from commoner status and made attendant cavalier, and Xi was summoned to serve as recorder on the staff of Prince of Guangping's opening office.

literal: Xi wished to support his mother and in the end did not accept appointment.
idiomatic: Xi wished to support his mother and in the end did not accept appointment.

literal: After his mother died he still went with the move to Ye.
idiomatic: After his mother died he still went with the move to Ye.

literal: Roaming in Gong and Luo, he delighted in the mountains and waters; with Lu Yuanming of Fanyang and Wei Jijing of Julu he formed a bond of like minds and went to Tianling Mountain, with vast resolve to end his days there.
idiomatic: Roaming in Gong and Luo, he delighted in the mountains and waters; with Lu Yuanming of Fanyang and Wei Jijing of Julu he formed a bond of like minds and went to Tianling Mountain, with vast resolve to end his days there.

literal: When Western Wei general Dugu Xin entered Luoyang, he appointed Xi recorder on his opening staff.
idiomatic: When Western Wei general Dugu Xin entered Luoyang, he appointed Xi recorder on his opening staff.

literal: Xi claimed he had earlier been bitten by a dog and was gravely ill and could not rise.
idiomatic: Xi claimed he had earlier been bitten by a dog and was gravely ill and could not rise.

literal: An old friend doubted the wound was not from a mad dog and wrote urging him to get up.
idiomatic: An old friend doubted the wound was not from a mad dog and wrote urging him to get up.

literal: Xi wrote back: "I am shamed by your care in asking after me and your order to rise from illness; following and pondering your kind intent, you seem to doubt that my wound may not have been from a mad dog.
idiomatic: Xi wrote back, "I am shamed by your care in asking after me and your order to rise from illness; following and pondering your kind intent, you seem to doubt that my wound may not have been from a mad dog.

literal: Would I wish it must have been mad? Only that reason admits no doubt.
idiomatic: Would I wish it must have been mad? Only that reason admits no doubt.

literal: As for your doubting it, there is also overstatement.
idiomatic: As for your doubting it, there is also overstatement.

literal: Since you doubt it was not mad, you may also doubt it was mad—your doubt is already half.
idiomatic: Since you doubt it was not mad, you may also doubt it was mad—your doubt is already half.

literal: If you doubt it was mad and nurse the wound, though it was not mad there is no harm; if you doubt it was not mad and do not treat it, perchance it was mad and then it is hard to save.
idiomatic: If you doubt it was mad and nurse the wound, though it was not mad there is no harm; if you doubt it was not mad and do not treat it, perchance it was mad and then it is hard to save.

literal: Thus overtreatment brings ten thousandfold safety; overt refusal of treatment may bring death.
idiomatic: Thus overtreatment brings ten thousandfold safety; overt refusal of treatment may bring death.

literal: If Wang Xi were not worth sparing, then he should not be taken; since he is taken, he is worth sparing.
idiomatic: If Wang Xi were not worth sparing, then he should not be taken; since he is taken, he is worth sparing.

literal: How can you strip him of ten thousandfold safety and leave him to possible death?
idiomatic: How can you strip him of ten thousandfold safety and leave him to possible death?

literal: Moreover the general's prestige and virtue cover all; wind flies and mist strikes, about to enfold the eight reaches—surely not for one man alone.
idiomatic: Moreover the general's prestige and virtue cover all; wind flies and mist strikes, about to enfold the eight reaches—surely not for one man alone.

literal: If you must begin from the start, first you must succor the living people.
idiomatic: If you must begin from the start, first you must succor the living people.

literal: Why do you not speak to the general at leisure on my behalf?
idiomatic: Why do you not speak to the general at leisure on my behalf?

literal: " Only then was he granted leniency.
idiomatic: " Only then was he granted leniency.

literal: Soon Dugu Xin returned west; Xi then went back to Ye.
idiomatic: Soon Dugu Xin returned west; Xi then went back to Ye.

literal: Gao Huan sought sons of the court who were loyal, filial, careful, and steady, to keep company with his sons.
idiomatic: Gao Huan sought sons of the court who were loyal, filial, careful, and steady, to keep company with his sons.

literal: Xi and Cui Zhan of Qinghe, Li Du of Dunqiu, and Lu Zhengtong of Fanyang were the first chosen for this.
idiomatic: Xi and Cui Zhan of Qinghe, Li Du of Dunqiu, and Lu Zhengtong of Fanyang were the first chosen for this.

literal: Gao Cheng was then grand general; he took Xi and the others by the hand and said: "My younger brothers are all growing up; their aims and knowledge are not yet fixed—near goodness they draw close, near evil they cannot but shift.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng was then grand general; he took Xi and the others by the hand and said, "My younger brothers are all growing up; their aims and knowledge are not yet fixed—near goodness they draw close, near evil they cannot but shift.

literal: If my younger brothers are established, they will not betray righteous teaching; your rank and salary will always rank just below my younger brothers.
idiomatic: If my younger brothers are established, they will not betray righteous teaching; your rank and salary will always rank just below my younger brothers.

literal: If you would make them turn crooked and lead one another astray, guilt will reach the clan—not you alone.
idiomatic: If you would make them turn crooked and lead one another astray, guilt will reach the clan—not you alone.

literal: " Xi followed Gao Huan to Jinyang, was made staff officer of the inner and outer offices, and attended Prince of Changshan Yan as companion.
idiomatic: " Xi followed Gao Huan to Jinyang, was made staff officer of the inner and outer offices, and attended Prince of Changshan Yan as companion.

literal: At the beginning of Tianbao in Qi he acted as administrator of Taiyuan commandery.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao in Qi he acted as administrator of Taiyuan commandery.

literal: When Gao Yang grew dissolute, Prince of Changshan remonstrated repeatedly; the emperor suspected the prince borrowed his words from Xi and wished to impose the death penalty.
idiomatic: When Gao Yang grew dissolute, Prince of Changshan remonstrated repeatedly; Gao Yang suspected the prince borrowed his words from Xi and wished to impose the death penalty.

literal: The prince said privately to Xi: "Doctor, tomorrow you must do one thing—for I mean to keep you alive and also to save myself; understand deeply and do not take it amiss.
idiomatic: The prince said privately to Xi, "Doctor, tomorrow you must do one thing—for I mean to keep you alive and also to save myself; understand deeply and do not take it amiss.

literal: " He then had Xi beaten twenty strokes before the assembly.
idiomatic: " He then had Xi beaten twenty strokes before the assembly.

literal: The emperor soon flared in anger; hearing Xi had been beaten, on that account he did not kill him but shaved his head, put him in fetters, and assigned him to the armorer's ward.
idiomatic: Gao Yang soon flared in anger; hearing Xi had been beaten, on that account he did not kill him but shaved his head, put him in fetters, and assigned him to the armorer's ward.

literal: After three years the prince again remonstrated firmly; he was beaten severely, closed his mouth and would not eat.
idiomatic: After three years the prince again remonstrated firmly; he was beaten severely, closed his mouth and would not eat.

literal: The empress dowager was deeply grieved.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was deeply grieved.

literal: The emperor said to those about him: "If the boy dies, what of my old mother?
idiomatic: Gao Yang said to those about him, "If the boy dies, what of my old mother?

literal: " He then each day inquired after the prince's illness and told him: "Strive and force yourself to eat; I will give Wang Xi back to you.
idiomatic: " He then each day inquired after the prince's illness and told him, "Strive and force yourself to eat; I will give Wang Xi back to you.

literal: " He released Xi and sent him to the prince.
idiomatic: " He released Xi and sent him to the prince.

literal: The prince embraced Xi and said: "My breath and strength are failing; I fear we shall not meet again.
idiomatic: The prince embraced Xi and said, "My breath and strength are failing; I fear we shall not meet again.

literal: " Xi wept and said: "Heaven's way and the spirits—how could they let Your Highness die in this house!
idiomatic: " Xi wept and said, "Heaven's way and the spirits—how could they let Your Highness die in this house!

literal: The Supreme One is elder brother in person and sovereign in rank—how can you contend with him?
idiomatic: The Supreme One is elder brother in person and sovereign in rank—how can you contend with him?

literal: Your Highness will not eat; the empress dowager will not eat either—if Your Highness will not spare yourself, will you not spare the empress dowager?
idiomatic: Your Highness will not eat; the empress dowager will not eat either—if Your Highness will not spare yourself, will you not spare the empress dowager?

literal: " Before he finished speaking, the prince forced himself to sit up and eat.
idiomatic: " Before he finished speaking, the prince forced himself to sit up and eat.

literal: Xi was thereby spared exile and returned as the prince's companion.
idiomatic: Xi was thereby spared exile and returned as the prince's companion.
